title: Passwords inside connection strings: must be flagged
summary: URIs (postgres, rediss and others) with a synthetic password in user-info or in the password-only position, and a twin with the password separator removed. Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: Only the password is secret. The scheme, user and host are not, and redacting them is acceptable but must not replace covering the password.

expectation.rationale: Independently authored public conformance row for the bounded credential project-policy contract.

sources.supports: Cited by the legacy assessment (provider documentation); claim not itemised.
